outcomes.statement: Can identify warmth, attentiveness and problem-solving in a hotel customer-care situation.
evidence_conditions: Selects or explains the service principle shown in a DOCX-derived scenario.

outcomes.statement: Can replace a negative service response with a simple, positive next-step response.
evidence_conditions: Produces a warm alternative that states what can be done and offers a next step.

outcomes.statement: Can record confidence and choose a next practice action without treating self-rating as proficiency.
evidence_conditions: Completes non-graded confidence check and names one next action.

outcomes.statement: Can greet a guest, confirm a reservation and close a routine check-in warmly.
evidence_conditions: Completes all opening, confirmation and closing stages in order.

outcomes.statement: Can request identification and confirm room and stay details accurately.
evidence_conditions: Elicits and repeats the required booking details without material error.

outcomes.statement: Can explain key-card, breakfast and hotel information and offer further help.
evidence_conditions: Provides the DOCX-specified information and a clear offer of help.

outcomes.statement: Can open and close a routine hotel telephone call professionally.
evidence_conditions: Uses hotel/name/offer-of-help opening and a polite close.

outcomes.statement: Can clarify, spell and read back caller details to confirm accuracy.
evidence_conditions: Requests clarification when needed and reads back all critical details.

outcomes.statement: Can take a short message and place, hold or transfer a call politely.
evidence_conditions: Records caller, contact and message; explains hold/transfer action.

outcomes.statement: Can identify a hotline caller’s room and service need.
evidence_conditions: Obtains and confirms room number and request.

outcomes.statement: Can take and read back a routine order and communicate an estimated time.
evidence_conditions: Order and timing match the prompt; read-back is complete.

outcomes.statement: Can transfer a request to the correct department and state a follow-up action.
evidence_conditions: Names correct handoff and a specific follow-up step.

outcomes.statement: Can structure a clear service email with suitable opening, body, action and close.
evidence_conditions: Includes all required sections and keeps a professional neutral register.

outcomes.statement: Can confirm booking or enquiry details accurately in writing.
evidence_conditions: Written details match the scenario and identify any next action.

outcomes.statement: Can respond to a written concern with thanks, apology, action and further-help language.
evidence_conditions: Response contains all four service-recovery components without unsupported promises.

outcomes.statement: Can produce a brief, warm and professional reply in live chat or social media.
evidence_conditions: Reply acknowledges the message, answers or routes it, and remains concise.

outcomes.statement: Can handle a routine online request using formulaic service language and clarification.
evidence_conditions: Obtains missing information and resolves or routes the routine request.

outcomes.statement: Can move a sensitive public complaint to a private channel and escalate with a clear next step.
evidence_conditions: Protects private details, names the private/escalation channel and commits to follow-up.

outcomes.statement: Can listen, acknowledge impact and apologise without blaming or dismissing the guest.
evidence_conditions: Response demonstrates empathy and a specific sincere apology.

outcomes.statement: Can explain the problem, take ownership and offer an appropriate solution or next action.
evidence_conditions: Explains issue, owns next action and offers an approved solution.

outcomes.statement: Can follow up a complaint orally or in writing to confirm resolution.
evidence_conditions: Checks resolution, records outcome and offers further help.

approval_requirements: Qualified ESP/CEFR reviewer checks every descriptor transcription and alignment rationale.
Hospitality practitioner checks task authenticity and evidence conditions.
Learner diagnostic evidence is compared before any public CEFR level claim.
